indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Dipped about 18 points after recovering most of a steep early slide.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Fell about 148 points as chip and AI stocks stayed under pressure.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Rose about 164 points after erasing an intraday loss of more than 1,100.

notes: October core PCE inflation came in at 3.3%, a touch above forecasts, and Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3%; markets now price a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.
A proposal for new 20% tariffs on China, the EU and a dozen other partners added to the early selling; they would not take effect before January.
AI and chip stocks led the drop, with Nvidia down about 4% after falling as much as 8% intraday; HP Inc. jumped about 11% on earnings while Ambarella and Nutanix fell 15–20% on weak outlooks.
events: Thu 26 Nov: US stock and bond markets closed for Thanksgiving.
Fri 27 Nov: half-day session, closing early at 21:00 Kuwait time.
Tue 8 – Wed 9 Dec: Fed policy meeting, with a rate hike widely expected.
